headline: Brazil eyes friendly match against Bangladesh in Dhaka
summary: BFF President Tabith Awal confirms discussions with the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) regarding a potential match in October.
details: The Bangladesh Football Federation (BFF) has discussed all possible options with a delegation from the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) during their recent visit to Dhaka.

Brazil is scheduled to play friendlies against Australia in September and face India in Kolkata on October 3. Discussions have centered on a potential friendly against Bangladesh in Dhaka on October 5 or 6.
BFF President Tabith Awal stated that the CBF delegation inspected facilities at the National Stadium and Bashundhara Kings Arena, finding the pitches to be of an acceptable standard.
While the pitches were approved, the delegation noted that some improvements are needed for dressing rooms, technical staff areas, and security at entry and exit gates.
The two organizations have also agreed to collaborate on infrastructure, pitch development, joint coaching programs, and sports science.
The official possibility of the match depends on whether Bangladesh can fit it into their schedule, as they are committed to the FIFA ASEAN Cup in Indonesia from September 24 to October 4.
caption:
Could the five-time world champions be coming to Dhaka? Brazil is exploring a friendly match against Bangladesh this October.

The Bangladesh Football Federation (BFF) has discussed all possible options with a delegation from the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) during their recent visit to Dhaka.

Brazil is scheduled to play friendlies against Australia in September and face India in Kolkata on October 3. Discussions have centered on a potential friendly against Bangladesh in Dhaka on October 5 or 6.

BFF President Tabith Awal stated that the CBF delegation inspected facilities at the National Stadium and Bashundhara Kings Arena, finding the pitches to be of an acceptable standard.

While the pitches were approved, the delegation noted that some improvements are needed for dressing rooms, technical staff areas, and security at entry and exit gates.

The two organizations have also agreed to collaborate on infrastructure, pitch development, joint coaching programs, and sports science.

The official possibility of the match depends on whether Bangladesh can fit it into their schedule, as they are committed to the FIFA ASEAN Cup in Indonesia from September 24 to October 4.

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: High Court delivers verdict in Nusrat murder case today
summary: The court is ruling on death references, appeals, and jail appeals of the convicts in the high-profile case of the madrasa student.
details: The High Court is currently delivering its verdict on the death references, appeals, and jail appeals of the convicts in the widely discussed Nusrat murder case.
A bench of Justice Bhishmadev Chakraborty and Justice K.M. Rasheduzzaman Raja set the date for the verdict this Monday, August 24.
In October 2019, the Feni Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal sentenced 16 people to death for the murder of the madrasa student.
The convicted individuals include Siraj-Ud-Daula, former Sonagazi Upazila Awami League president Ruhul Amin, Sonagazi municipality councillor Maksudul Alam, and several madrasa teachers and students.
Hearings on the death references and appeals in this high-profile case concluded on August 20.
caption:
The High Court is ruling today on the fate of 16 people sentenced to death in the Nusrat murder case.

A bench of Justice Bhishmadev Chakraborty and Justice K.M. Rasheduzzaman Raja set the date for the verdict this Monday, August 24.

In October 2019, the Feni Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal sentenced 16 people to death for the murder of the madrasa student.

The convicted individuals include Siraj-Ud-Daula, former Sonagazi Upazila Awami League president Ruhul Amin, Sonagazi municipality councillor Maksudul Alam, and several madrasa teachers and students.

Hearings on the death references and appeals in this high-profile case concluded on August 20.
